title: NBA: Pacers and Nuggets gear up for Mexico City showdown
summary: NBA players Nikola Jokic and Pascal Siakam praised Mexican fans on Friday (November 6) as the Denver Nuggets and Indiana Pacers prepare to face off in Mexico City.
